items.title: Chazz Frichtel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 13, 2016
items.q: Aretha Franklin played here once and I got to play in the horn section.

ctx.x: I don’t know — if I was nervous it was more excitement. Her act was more of a cabaret kind of act. But it was kind of one of my first encounters with celebrity and of course I couldn’t look at her without seeing the 2000 B.C. poster that a lot of us had. But she was very nice and she made me feel welcome and at ease and she was really fun to work with.
It’s funny you say that because Aretha Franklin played here once and I got to play in the horn section.
